mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_verifications (user_id, method, real_name_cipher, student_number_cipher, student_number_hash, school, department, evidence_url, status, reviewer_id, reject_reason, created_at, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{method}, #{realNameCipher}, #{studentNumberCipher}, #{studentNumberHash}, #{school}, #{department}, #{evidenceUrl}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{rejectReason}, #{createdAt}, #{reviewedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM campus_verifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_verifications SET user_id = #{userId}, method = #{method}, real_name_cipher = #{realNameCipher}, student_number_cipher = #{studentNumberCipher}, student_number_hash = #{studentNumberHash}, school = #{school}, department = #{department}, evidence_url = #{evidenceUrl}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, created_at = #{createdAt}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
